title: TryItWorkspaceDocument
description: tryItWorkspaces/{uid}: the one try-it workspace of a phone-verified account (owner decision, 18 Nov 2026). The workspace is an ordinary private organizer the account owns (organizers/{organizerId}, made by stageOwnedOrganizerCreate); this record only points to it and tracks expiry. An untouched workspace is removed 30 days after its last command unless it was kept: published, given an event of its own, a second team member, or kept explicitly. A caller who already owns exactly one organizer gets that organizer as their workspace, kept. Server only.

generation.description: Counts workspaces this account has had. A workspace made again after one expired gets a new organizer id, so it never reuses the old page address.

expiresAt.description: Null once kept or expired, so the expiry sweep's range query never reads it again.
